bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'HOST_REPO_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
printf 'TARGET_ROOT=%s\n' "$ROOT"
printf 'WORKTREE_LIST\n'; git worktree list --porcelain | sed -n '1,60p'
printf 'BOT_CONTAINER='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Status}} {{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'BOT_IMAGE_TAG='; docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}' 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'BOT_MOUNTS\n'; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Destination}} {{.Type}}{{println}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'BOT_PR_STORAGE_ENV='; docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' 2>/dev/null | grep '^PROFILE_PR_STORAGE_DIR=' | cut -d= -f1 || true
printf 'PROFILE_BRANCH_REMOTE='; git ls-remote origin refs/heads/feat/profile-recruitment-album-20261114 | cut -f1
